tolerance_basis: Attachment 4 contains rounded scientific-notation values: 4VG and t2n have two residuals between 1e-8 and 1e-7. Other nonconstant-target residuals are below 5e-10.
identity_rule: Use only targets with positive within-taster SD for every taster; require exactly one beer match in each direction within the per-cell tolerance. Row order and same-number IDs are diagnostics, not linkage rules.
normalization_scope: Retrospective provenance diagnostics, not a preregistered model comparison. Never estimate missing zero-SD constants from attachment 4 and call that independent reproduction.
repeat_policy: Retain all session-position-taster events; same beer tasted at different positions or sessions is not an accidental duplicate.
label_policy: Report record-weighted mean/median and equal-taster mean as alternatives. No final aggregation, rounding rule, or new training target is selected in this task.
fold_basis: Reuse current final_protocol.json split settings, stratify contest fine styles at beer level, then propagate each beer's fold to all raw rating records.
